_comment: Standard RNN-T transducer ASR (greek_asr.models.transducer). max_steps/batch_size/gradient_accumulation_steps are left pending: Serdar's pilot must measure real step time/VRAM before a non-arbitrary training-length decision. See docs/SEQUENCE_MODELS.md.
